name: Ore no Imouto ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai Portable ga Tsuzuku Wake ga Nai
original_name: 俺の妹がこんなに可愛いわけがない ポータブルが続くわけがない
source: This is an expanded content to Oreimo portable which deals with the events for each heroine after the protagonist, Kyousuke Kousaka, started dating them in the previous game. In addition to the five heroines from the previous game (Kirino, Kuroneko, Saori, Ayase, and Manami), this installment includes new scenarios for Kanako, who was previously a hidden heroine, and Sena.
translation: 这是《Oreimo port》的扩展内容，讲述了前作中主角高坂恭介开始约会后各女主角所发生的事情。除了前作中的五位女主角（桐乃、黑猫、沙织、绫濑和真波）之外，本作还包括了此前隐藏女主角加奈子和濑奈的新剧本。
